name: dsh-pet-indesktop
description: 给 DSH 网页界面加一只叫「大肥鱼」的桌宠（鲸鲸），八种配色皮肤随时切换，并且有性格：她只吃米饭、聪明但懒、嘴硬心软；被连点几次就躺平不干了，被叫「大肥鱼」会生气并坚持自己不胖，叫「鲸鲸」才高兴，十分钟没人理就游去角落（只改视觉，不改你放她的位置）。A desktop pet called "Big Fat Fish" (nickname Jingjing) for the DSH web GUI, with eight switchable colour skins and a personality: she eats rice, is clever but lazy, and is a tsundere. Too many rapid clicks and she lies down and refuses to react; calling her "fat" annoys her and she insists she is not; the nickname 鲸鲸 pleases her; ten quiet minutes and she drifts to a corner — visually only, never moving the position you chose. The eight images are PNGs bundled with the plugin and served by the plugin itself.
author: Gjs9178U
